records.matn_en: ’Abdullah said: “Your Prophet was given everything except the keys of the five: {Indeed, God has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs} [Luqman: 34]” – meaning, the whole verse.

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الصَّلْتِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَقْرَبٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَتَيْنَا ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَوَجَدْنَاهُ فَوْقَ الْبَيْتِ، فَسَمِعْنَاهُ يَقُولُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ قُلْنَا لَهُ: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ سَمِعْنَاكَ تَقُولُ: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ: «لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فِي النِّصْفِ مِنَ السَّبْعِ الْأَوَاخِرِ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ الشَّمْسَ تَطْلُعُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَيْضَاءَ لَا شُعَاعَ لَهَا» ، فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى الشَّمْسِ فَوَجَدْتُهَا كَمَا حَدَّثَ، فَكَبَّرْتُ
records.isnad_en: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Abu Ya’fur, from Abu al-Salt, from Abu ’Aqrab al-Asadi, who said:
records.matn_en: We came to Ibn Mas’ud and found him on top of the house, and we heard him say before he came down: God and His Messenger spoke the truth. When he came down we said to him: O Abu ’Abd al-Rahman, we heard you say: God and His Messenger spoke the truth. He said: “The Night of Qadr is in the middle of the last seven [nights], and that is because the sun rises that day white, without rays.” I looked at the sun and found it as he had said, and I said Allahu Akbar.

records.isnad_ar: نا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ مَرْزُوقٍ، نَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ الْجُهَنِيُّ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: " مَا قَالَ أَحَدٌ قَطُّ إِذَا أَصَابَهُ هَمٌ أَوْ حَزَنٌ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي، إِلَّا أَذْهَبَ اللَّهُ هَمَّهُ، وَأَبْدَلَهُ مَكَانَ حُزْنِهِ فَرَحًا "، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَنْبَغِي لَنَا أَنْ نَتَعَلَّمَ هَؤُلَاءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ؟ قَالَ: «أَجَلْ، لِمَنْ سَمِعَهُنَّ أَنْ يَتَعَلَّمَهُنَّ»
records.isnad_en: Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us, from Fudayl ibn Marzuq, Abu Salama al-Juhani narrated to us, from al-Qasim ibn ’Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Ibn Mas’ud, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “No one is afflicted with worry or grief and says: ‘O God, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant; my forelock is in Your hand, Your command over me is executed, Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, by which You named Yourself, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept to Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen, that You make the Qur’an the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the removal of my sorrow and the departure of my worry,’ except that God removes his worry and replaces his grief with joy.” They said: O Messenger of God, should we learn these words? He said: “Yes, whoever hears them should learn them.”

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " أَفْضَلُ الْحَجِّ: الْعَجُّ وَالثَّجُّ ". فَأَمَّا الْعَجُّ: فَالتَّلْبِيَةُ، وَأَمَّا الثَّجُّ، فَنَحْرُ الدِّمَاءِ
records.isnad_en: Abu Usama narrated to us, from Abu Hanifa, from Qays ibn Muslim, from Tariq ibn Shihab, from ’Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “The best Hajj is al-’ajj and al-thajj.” As for al-’ajj, it is the talbiya, and as for al-thajj, it is the sacrificing of animals.

records.isnad_ar: نا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
records.matn_ar: قَالَ ⦗ص: 225⦘ : بِتُّ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَأَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ يَقْنُتُ فِي وِتْرِهِ قَبْلَ رُكُوعِهِ، ثُمَّ لَقِيتُ أُمِّي أُمَّ عَبْدٍ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا: بِيتِي مَعَ نِسَائِهِ فَانْظُرِي كَيْفَ يَقْنُتُ فِي وِتْرِهِ، فَأَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّهُ «قَنَتَ بَعْدَ رُكُوعِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us, from Aban ibn Abi ’Ayyash, from Ibrahim, from ’Alqama, from ’Abdullah, who said [p. 225]:
records.matn_en: I spent the night with the Messenger of God ﷺ to see how he performed qunut in his Witr, before bowing. Then I met my mother Umm ’Abd and said to her: Spend the night with his wives and see how he performs qunut in his Witr. She told me that “he performed qunut after bowing.”

flags: A further narration inside the story is kept with the matn.
records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّزَّالَ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا يَقْرَأُ آيَةً، فَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ خِلَافَ مَا يَقْرَأُهُ الرَّجُلُ، قَالَ: فَجِئْتُ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: فَعَرَفْتُ الْغَضَبَ فِي وَجْهِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «كِلَاكُمَا مُحْسِنٌ، إِنَّ مَنْ قَبْلَكُمُ اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ فَأَهْلَكَهُمُ اللَّهُ، فَلَا تَخْتَلِفُوا فِيهِ»
records.isnad_en: Abu Usama narrated to us, from Shu’ba, from ’Abd al-Malik ibn Maysara, who said:
records.matn_en: I heard al-Nazzal say: ’Abdullah said: I heard a man recite a verse, and I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ recite it differently from how the man recited it. He said: I brought him to the Prophet ﷺ, and I recognized anger on the face of the Messenger of God ﷺ. He said: “Both of you are doing well. Those before you differed about it and God destroyed them, so do not differ about it.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، عَنِ الْمَسْعُودِيِّ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ ⦗ص: 226⦘ ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: " إِنَّ اللَّهَ اتَّخَذَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلًا، وَإِنَّ صَاحِبَكُمْ خَلِيلُ اللَّهِ، وَإِنَّ مُحَمَّدًا أَكْرَمُ الْخَلْقِ عَلَى اللَّهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: {عَسَى أَنْ يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا} [الإسراء: 79] "
records.isnad_en: ’Ali ibn Hafs narrated to us, from al-Mas’udi, from ’Asim, from Abu Wa’il [p. 226], who said:
records.matn_en: ’Abdullah said: “God took Abraham as a close friend, and your companion is the close friend of God, and Muhammad is the most honored of creation to God.” Then he recited: {Perhaps your Lord will raise you to a praised station} [al-Isra’: 79].

records.isnad_ar: نا خَالِدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، نَا زُبَيْدٌ، نَا أَبُو حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: خَلَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَعْلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَخَلَعَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ نِعَالَهُمْ، فَقَالَ: «مَا حَمَلَكُمْ عَلَى خَلْعِ نِعَالَكُمْ؟» ، فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: رَأَيْنَاكَ خَلَعْتَ فَخَلَعْنَا، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ عليه السلام أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ فِي أَحَدِهِمَا قَذَرًا فَخَلَعْتُهُمَا مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ، فَلَا تَخْلَعُوا نِعَالَكُمْ»
records.isnad_en: Khalid ibn Isma’il narrated to us, Zubayd narrated to us, Abu Hamza narrated to us, from Ibrahim, from ’Alqama, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ took off his sandals while he was praying, and those behind him took off their sandals. He said: “What made you take off your sandals?” They said: O Messenger of God, we saw you take yours off, so we took ours off. He said: “Gabriel (peace be upon him) told me that there was filth on one of them, so I took them off for that reason; so do not take off your sandals.”

records.isnad_ar: نا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ مِنْدَلٍ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.matn_ar: ⦗ص: 227⦘ : «إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَهْلَهُ فَلْيَسْتَتِرْ، وَلَا يَتَجَرَّدْ تَجَرُّدَ الْعِيرَيْنِ»
records.isnad_en: Malik ibn Isma’il narrated to us, from Mindal, from al-A’mash, from Abu Wa’il, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said [p. 227]:
records.matn_en: “When one of you goes to his wife, let him cover himself and not strip bare like a pair of donkeys.”

narrators.ar: أَبُو خَالِدٍ الْأَحْمَرُ، وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ
narrators.en: Abu Khalid al-Ahmar, Sulayman ibn Hayyan and Abu Mu’awiya

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الْأَحْمَرُ، وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ خِشْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ:
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «جَعَلَ دِيَةَ الْخَطَأِ أَخْمَاسًا»
records.isnad_en: Abu Khalid al-Ahmar, Sulayman ibn Hayyan and Abu Mu’awiya narrated to us, from al-Hajjaj, from Zayd ibn Jubayr, from Khishf ibn Malik, from ’Abdullah:
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ “set the blood-money for accidental killing in five categories.”

records.isnad_ar: نا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ، ثنَا سَيَّارٌ أَبُو ⦗ص:
records.matn_ar: 228⦘ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ نَزَلَتْ بِهِ فَاقَةٌ فَأَنْزَلَهَا بِالنَّاسِ لَمْ تُسَدَّ فَاقَتُهُ، وَمَنْ أَنْزَلَهَا بِاللَّهِ أَوْشَكَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُ بِالْغِنَى، إِمَّا غِنًى آجِلٌ، وَإِمَّا غِنًى عَاجِلٌ»
records.isnad_en: al-Fadl ibn Dukayn narrated to us, from Bishr ibn Abi Isma’il, Sayyar Abu [p. 228] al-Hakam narrated to us, from Tariq ibn Shihab, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever is struck by need and lays it before people, his need will not be met; and whoever lays it before God, God will soon bring him sufficiency, either delayed or immediate.”

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَسَدِيِّ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ مُخَارِقٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: لَقَدْ شَهِدْتُ مِنَ الْمِقْدَادِ مَشْهَدًا لَأَنْ أَكُونَ صَاحِبُهُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا عُدِلَ بِهِ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَدْعُو عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَقَالَ: " يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لَا نَقُولُ لَكَ كَمَا قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَى لِمُوسَى: {اذْهَبْ أَنْتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلَا إِنَّا هَاهُنَا قَاعِدُونَ} ، وَلَكِنَّا نُقَاتِلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْكَ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِكَ، وَعَنْ يَمِينِكَ، وَعَنْ شِمَالِكَ، قَالَ: فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَشْرَقَ وَجْهُهُ بِذَلِكَ وَسَرَّهُ وَأَعْجَبَهُ "
records.isnad_en: From Muhammad ibn ’Abdullah al-Asadi, from Isra’il, from Mukhariq, from Tariq ibn Shihab, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: I witnessed from al-Miqdad a scene such that to have been its protagonist would be dearer to me than anything equal to it. He came to the Prophet ﷺ while he was invoking against the polytheists and said: “O Messenger of God, we will not say to you as the people of Moses said to Moses: {Go, you and your Lord, and fight; we are staying right here}, but we will fight before you, behind you, on your right and on your left.” He said: I saw the face of the Messenger of God ﷺ light up, and he was pleased and delighted by it.

records.isnad_ar: نا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 229⦘ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «لَا يُعْدِي شَيْءٌ شَيْئًا»
records.isnad_en: ’Abda ibn Sulayman narrated to us, from Sufyan, from ’Umara ibn al-Qa’qa’, from [p. 229] Abu Zur’a, from a man, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Nothing infects another.”

records.isnad_ar: نا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ الْمَسْعُودِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " عَلَّمَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خُطْبَةَ الصَّلَاةِ وَخُطْبَةَ الْحَاجَةِ، فَأَمَّا خُطْبَةُ الصَّلَاةِ: فَالتَّشَهُّدُ، وَأَمَّا خُطْبَةُ الْحَاجَةِ: فَإِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ نَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ، وَنَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا، مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللَّهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ، وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ "، قَالَ: ثُمَّ نَقْرَأُ ثَلَاثَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: {اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا، يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ} [الأحزاب: 71] ⦗ص: 230⦘ الْآيَاتِ، ثُمَّ تَعْمَدُ لِحَاجَتِكَ
records.isnad_en: Humayd ibn ’Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from al-Mas’udi, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ taught us the sermon of prayer and the sermon of need. As for the sermon of prayer, it is the tashahhud; and as for the sermon of need: ‘Praise belongs to God; we seek His help and His forgiveness, and we seek refuge in God from the evils of our souls. Whomever God guides, none can misguide, and whomever He misguides, none can guide. I bear witness that there is no god but God, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.’” He said: Then we recite three verses from the Book of God: {Fear God and speak words of appropriate justice. He will amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins} [al-Ahzab: 71] [p. 230] and the following verses; then you proceed to your need.

records.isnad_ar: نا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُ: «أَقْرَأْ» ، فَافْتَتَحَ النِّسَاءَ، حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ: {فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلَاءِ شَهِيدًا} [النساء: 41] ، فَدَمَعَتْ عَيْنَا النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ: «حَسْبُكَ»
records.isnad_en: Husayn ibn ’Ali narrated to us, from Za’ida, from ’Asim, from Zirr, from ’Abdullah,
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: “Recite,” and he began Surat al-Nisa’ until he reached His saying: {How will it be when We bring from every nation a witness, and bring you against these as a witness?} [al-Nisa’: 41]. The eyes of the Prophet ﷺ filled with tears and he said: “That is enough for you.”

records.isnad_ar: نا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَمْ يَقْنُتِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَّا شَهْرًا، لَمْ يَقْنُتْ قَبْلَهُ وَلَا بَعْدَهُ»
records.isnad_en: Malik ibn Isma’il narrated to us, from Sharik, from Abu Hamza, from Ibrahim, from ’Alqama, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Prophet ﷺ did not perform qunut except for a month; he did not do so before it or after it.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، نَا أَبَانُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، نَا صَبَاحُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَحْمَسِيُّ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «اسْتَحْيُوا مِنَ اللَّهِ حَقَّ الْحَيَاءِ» ، قُلْتُ: إِنَّا لَنَسْتَحِي يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ، وَلَكِنْ مَنِ اسْتَحْيَا مِنَ اللَّهِ حَقَّ الْحَيَاءِ فَلْيَحْفَظِ الرَّأْسَ وَمَا وَعَى، وَالْبَطْنَ وَمَا حَوَى، وَلْيَذْكُرِ الْمَوْتَ وَالْبِلَى، وَمَنْ أَرَادَ الْآخِرَةَ تَرَكَ زِينَةَ الدُّنْيَا، مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدِ اسْتَحْيَا مِنَ اللَّهِ حَقَّ الْحَيَاءِ»
records.isnad_en: ’Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us, Aban ibn Ishaq narrated to us, al-Sabbah ibn Muhammad al-Ahmasi narrated to us, from Murra al-Hamdani, from ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Be modest before God as is His due.” I said: We are modest, O Prophet of God. He said: “Not that. Rather, whoever is modest before God as is His due, let him guard the head and what it contains, and the belly and what it holds, and let him remember death and decay; and whoever wants the Hereafter abandons the adornment of the world. Whoever does so has been modest before God as is His due.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، نَا أَبَانُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الصَّبَّاحِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَحْمَسِيِّ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ ⦗ص: 232⦘ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَسَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ أَخْلَاقَكُمْ، كَمَا قَسَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ أَرْزَاقَكُمْ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُعْطِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ يُحِبُّ وَمَنْ لَا يُحِبُّ، وَلَا يُعْطِي الدِّينَ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَحَبَّ، فَمَنْ أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ جَلَّ وَعَزَّ الدِّينَ فَقَدْ أَحَبَّهُ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَا يُسْلِمُ عَبْدٌ حَتَّى يُسْلِمَ قَلْبُهُ وَلِسَانُهُ، وَلَا يُؤْمِنُ حَتَّى يَأْمَنَ جَارُهُ بَوَائِقَهُ» قَالَ: قُلْنَا وَمَا بَوَائِقُهُ؟، قَالَ: «غَشْمُهُ وَظُلْمُهُ» ، قَالَ: «وَلَا كَسَبَ عَبْدٌ مَالًا حَرَامًا فَيُبَارِكَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ، وَلَا يَتَصَدَّقُ فَيُتَقَبَّلَ مِنْهُ، وَلَا يَتْرُكُهُ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ إِلَّا كَانَ قَائِدُهُ إِلَى النَّارِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَلَّ وَعَزَّ لَا يَمْحُو السَّيِّئَ بِالسَّيِّئِ، وَلَكِنْ يَمْحُو السَّيِّئَ بِالْحَسَنِ، إِنَّ الْخَبِيثَ لَا يَمْحُو الْخَبِيثَ»
records.isnad_en: ’Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us, Aban ibn Ishaq narrated to us, from al-Sabbah ibn Muhammad al-Ahmasi, from Murra al-Hamdani, from ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said [p. 232]:
records.matn_en: “God has apportioned your character among you as He apportioned your provisions. God gives the world to whom He loves and whom He does not love, but He gives religion only to whom He loves. So whoever God, Mighty and Majestic, gives religion has been loved by Him. By Him in whose hand is my soul, no servant becomes a Muslim until his heart and tongue submit, and none believes until his neighbor is safe from his harms (bawa’iq).” He said: We said: What are his harms? He said: “His oppression and injustice.” He said: “No servant earns unlawful money and has God bless it, nor gives charity from it and has it accepted, nor leaves it behind him except that it is his guide to the Fire. God, Mighty and Majestic, does not erase evil with evil, but erases evil with good; the vile does not erase the vile.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، نَا مُعَاوِيَةُ النَّصْرِيُّ،
records.matn_ar: - وَكَانَ ثِقَةً -، عَنْ نَهْشَلٍ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ مُزَاحِمٍ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: لَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْعِلْمِ صَانُوا عِلْمَهُمْ، وَوَضَعُوهُ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهِ لَسَادُوا بِهِ أَهْلَ زَمَانِهِمْ، وَلَكِنْ بَذَلُوهُ لِأَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا لِيَنَالُوا بِهِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ فَهَانُوا عَلَى أَهْلِهَا، سَمِعْتُ نَبِيَّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَنْ جَعَلَ الْهُمُومَ هَمًّا وَاحِدًا كَفَاهُ اللَّهُ هَمَّ آخِرَتِهِ، وَمَنْ تَشَعَّبَتْ بِهِ الْهُمُومُ وَأَحْوَالُ الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يُبَالِ فِي أَيِّ وَادٍ مِنْهَا وَقَعَ»
records.isnad_en: ’Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us, Mu’awiya al-Nasri narrated to us – and he was trustworthy – from Nahshal, from al-Dahhak ibn Muzahim, from al-Aswad, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: Had the people of knowledge protected their knowledge and placed it with those who deserve it, they would have led the people of their time by it; but they gave it to the people of the world to gain some of their worldly goods, so they became despised by them. I heard your Prophet ﷺ say: “Whoever makes his concerns a single concern, God will suffice him in the concern of his Hereafter; and whoever is scattered by concerns and worldly circumstances, God will not care in which valley of them he perishes.”

records.isnad_ar: نا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَاةَ الْخَوْفِ، فَقَامُوا صَفَّيْنِ، فَقَامَ صَفٌّ خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَصَفٌّ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْعَدُوِّ، وَصَلَّى بِهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَةً، وَجَاءَ الْآخَرُونَ فَقَامُوا مَقَامَهُمْ وَاسْتَقْبَلَ هَؤُلَاءِ الْعَدُوَّ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ، فَقَامَ هَؤُلَاءِ فَصَلُّوا لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ ثُمَّ سَلَّمُوا»
records.isnad_en: Muhammad ibn Fudayl narrated to us, from Khusayf, from Abu ’Ubayda, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ led us in the fear prayer. They formed two rows: one row stood behind the Prophet ﷺ and one row faced the enemy. The Messenger of God ﷺ prayed one rak’a with them, then the others came and took their place, and the first row faced the enemy; the Messenger of God ﷺ prayed one rak’a with them and then gave the salam. These then stood and prayed on their own, and then gave the salam.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ ⦗ص: 234⦘ : «فِي ثَلَاثِينَ مِنَ الْبَقَرِ تَبِيعٌ أَوْ تَبِيعَةٌ، وَفِي أَرْبَعِينَ مُسِنَّةٌ»
records.isnad_en: ’Abd al-Salam ibn Harb narrated to us, from Khusayf, from Abu ’Ubayda, from ’Abdullah,
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said [p. 234]: “For thirty cattle, a tabi’ or tabi’a (a one-year-old calf); and for forty, a musinna (a two-year-old).”

records.isnad_ar: نا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنِ الْعَوَّامِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ،:
records.matn_ar: مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَيُّمَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ مَضَى لَهُمَا مِنْ أَوْلَادِهِمَا ثَلَاثَةٌ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا حِنْثًا أَدْخَلَهُمَا اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ» ، فَقَالَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ: مَضَى لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اثْنَانِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «وَاثْنَانِ» ، فَقَالَ أَبُو الْمُنْذِرِ - سَيِّدُ الْقُرَّاءِ -: مَضَى لِي وَاحِدٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «وَوَاحِدٌ، وَذَلِكَ فِي الصَّدْمَةِ الْأُولَى»
records.isnad_en: Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us, from al-’Awwam ibn Hawshab, who said: Abu Muhammad, freedman of ’Umar ibn al-Khattab, narrated to me, from Abu ’Ubayda, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Any two Muslims who lose three of their children who had not reached puberty, God will admit them to Paradise.” Abu Dharr said: Two have passed on for me, O Messenger of God. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “And two.” Abu al-Mundhir, the master of the reciters, said: One has passed on for me, O Messenger of God. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “And one, and that is at the first shock.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «يَصُومُ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ غُرَّةَ كُلِّ هِلَالٍ، مَا كَانَ يُفْطِرُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ»
records.isnad_en: ’Abdullah ibn Musa narrated to us, from ’Asim, from Zirr, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ “used to fast three days at the beginning of each month, and he did not break his fast on Friday.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَخَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِشَاءَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ، وَإِذَا النَّاسُ يَنْتَظِرُونَ الصَّلَاةَ، فَقَالَ: «أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْأَدْيَانِ أَحَدٌ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ غَيْرُكُمْ» ، قَالَ: وَأُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ: {لَيْسُوا سَوَاءً مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ أُمَّةٌ قَائِمَةٌ} [آل عمران: 113] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ {وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالْمُتَّقِينَ} [آل عمران: 115] "
records.isnad_en: ’Ubaydullah ibn Musa narrated to us, from Shayban, from ’Asim, from Zirr, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ delayed the ’Isha’ prayer, then went out to the mosque, and the people were waiting for the prayer. He said: “None of the followers of these religions remembers God at this hour except you.” He said: And this verse was revealed: {They are not all alike; among the People of the Scripture is a community standing [in obedience]} [Al ’Imran: 113] to His saying {and God is Knowing of the righteous} [Al ’Imran: 115].

records.isnad_ar: نا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ ⦗ص: 236⦘ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنَّا نَمْشِي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَمَرَرْنَا عَلَى صِبْيَانٍ يَلْعَبُونَ، فَتَفَرَّقُوا حِينَ رَأَوُا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَلَسَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ، فَكَأَنَّهُ غَاظَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهُ: «مَا لَكَ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكَ، تَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟» فَقَالَ: أَتَشْهَدُ أَنْتَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ دَعْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَقْتُلُ هَذَا الْخَبِيثَ، فَقَالَ: «دَعْهُ، فَإِنْ يَكُنِ الَّذِي تَخَوُّفُ فَلَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ قَتْلَهُ»
records.isnad_en: ’Ubaydullah ibn Musa narrated to us, from Shayban, from al-A’mash, from Shaqiq [p. 236], from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: We were walking with the Messenger of God ﷺ and passed some boys playing; they scattered when they saw the Prophet ﷺ, and Ibn Sayyad sat. It seemed to anger the Prophet ﷺ, who said to him: “What is wrong with you, may your hands be dusty! Do you testify that I am the Messenger of God?” He said: Do you testify that I am the Messenger of God? ’Umar said: Let me, O Messenger of God, kill this vile one. He said: “Leave him. If he is the one you fear, you will not be able to kill him.”

records.isnad_ar: نا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْأَسَدِيُّ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " رَأَيْتُ الْأُمَمَ فَأَعْجَبَتْنِي كَثْرَتُهُمْ وَهَيْئَتُهُمْ، وَقَدْ مَلَؤُوا السَّهْلَ وَالْجَبَلَ، فَقِيلَ لِي: أَرَضِيتَ؟ قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: جَعَلْتُ فِي أُمَّتِكَ مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ "، فَقَالَ عُكَّاشَةُ بْنُ مِحْصَنٍ ⦗ص: 237⦘ الْأَسَدِيُّ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ، فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ» ، فَقَامَ آخَرُ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ، فَقَالَ: «قَدْ سَبَقَكَ إِلَيْهَا عُكَّاشَةُ»
records.isnad_en: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Asadi narrated to us, from Hammad ibn Salama, from ’Asim, from Zirr, from ’Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “I saw the nations and was impressed by their numbers and appearance; they filled the plain and the mountain. It was said to me: Are you pleased? I said: Yes. He said: I have placed in your community of these seventy thousand who will enter Paradise without reckoning.” ’Ukkasha ibn Mihsan [p. 237] al-Asadi said: O Messenger of God, pray to God that He make me one of them. He said: “O God, make him one of them.” Another man stood and said: O Messenger of God, pray to God that He make me one of them. He said: “’Ukkasha has beaten you to it.”

records.isnad_ar: نا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعُمَيْسِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَلْقَ اللَّهَ غَدًا مُسْلِمًا فَلْيُحَافِظْ عَلَى هَؤُلَاءِ الصَّلَوَاتِ حِينَ يُنَادَى بِهِنَّ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَرَعَ لِنَبِيِّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُنَنَ الْهُدَى، وَإِنَّهُنَّ مِنْ سُنَنِ الْهُدَى، وَلَوْ أَنَّكُمْ صَلَّيْتُمْ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ كَمَا يُصَلِّي هَذَا الْمُصَلِّي فِي بَيْتِهِ لَتَرَكْتُمْ سُنَّةَ نَبِيِّكُمْ، وَلَوْ تَرَكْتُمْ سُنَّةَ نَبِيِّكُمْ لَضَلَلْتُمْ، وَمَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَتَطَهَّرُ فَيُحْسِنُ الطَّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَعْمِدُ إِلَى مَسْجِدٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُ بِكُلِّ خُطْوَةٍ يَخْطُوهَا حَسَنَةً، وَتَرْفَعُهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً، وَتَحُطُّ بِهَا عَنْهُ سَيِّئَةٌ، وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا وَمَا يَتَخَلَّفُ عَنْهَا إِلَّا مُنَافِقٌ مَعْلُومُ النِّفَاقِ، وَلَقَدْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ يُؤْتَى بِهِ يُهَادَى بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ حَتَّى يُقَامَ فِي الصَّفِّ»
records.isnad_en: al-Fadl ibn Dukayn narrated to us, from Abu al-’Umays, from ’Ali ibn al-Aqmar, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever would be pleased to meet God tomorrow as a Muslim, let him maintain these prayers when they are called, for God has legislated for your Prophet ﷺ the ways of guidance, and they are among the ways of guidance. Had you prayed in your homes as this one prays in his house, you would have abandoned the Sunna of your Prophet, and had you abandoned the Sunna of your Prophet, you would have gone astray. No man purifies himself and does ablution well, then heads to one of these mosques, but that a good deed is written for him with every step he takes, and he is raised a degree by it and a sin is removed from him by it. And I have seen us, and none stayed away from it except a hypocrite whose hypocrisy was known; a man would be brought, supported between two men, until he was stood in the row.”

records.isnad_ar: نا وَكِيعٌ، نَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ الصَّادِقُ الْمَصْدُوقُ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «بَيْعُ الْمُحَفَّلَاتِ خِلَابَةٌ، وَلَا تَحِلُّ الْخِلَابَةُ لِمُسْلِمٍ»
records.isnad_en: Waki’ narrated to us, al-Mas’udi narrated to us, from Jabir, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ, the truthful, the believed, told us: “The sale of muhaffalat (animals whose udders are bound to appear full) is deception, and deception is not lawful for a Muslim.”

records.isnad_ar: نا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ⦗ص:
records.matn_ar: 239⦘ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَيْسَ الْمُؤْمِنُ بِالطَّعَّانِ، وَلَا اللَّعَّانِ، وَلَا بِالْفَاحِشِ، وَلَا بِالْبَذِيءِ»
records.isnad_en: Ahmad ibn ’Abdullah narrated to us, from Abu Bakr, from al-Hasan ibn ’Amr [p. 239], from Muhammad ibn ’Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from his father ’Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The believer is not a slanderer, nor a curser, nor indecent, nor foul-mouthed.”

records.isnad_ar: نا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْجَابِرِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَاجِدَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: سَأَلْنَا ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ عَنِ السَّيْرِ بِالْجِنَازَةِ، فَقَالَ: «دُونَ الْخَبَبِ، فَإِنْ يَكُنْ خَيْرًا أُعْجِلَ إِلَيْهِ، وَإِنْ يَكُنْ سِوَى ذَلِكَ فَبُعْدًا لِأَهْلِ النَّارِ، الْجِنَازَةُ مَتْبُوعَةٌ وَلَا تُتْبَعُ، وَلَيْسَ مِنْهَا مَنْ يَقْدُمُهَا»
records.isnad_en: Muhammad ibn Fudayl narrated to us, from Yahya ibn al-Jabir, from Abu Majida, who said:
records.matn_en: We asked Ibn Mas’ud about walking with a funeral. He said: “Slower than a trot. If it is good, hasten to it; if it is otherwise, then away with the people of the Fire. The funeral is followed and does not follow, and the one who walks ahead of it is not of it.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عُمَرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الطَّنَافِسِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «يُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ حَتَّى يَبْدُو بَيَاضُ خَدِّهِ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ، وَيُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ»
records.isnad_en: ’Umar ibn ’Ubayd al-Tanafisi narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ “would give the salam to his right until the whiteness of his cheek could be seen: Peace be upon you and the mercy of God, and to his left likewise.”

records.isnad_ar: نا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ جِبْرِيلَ فِي صُورَتِهِ عَلَى السِّدْرَةِ لَهُ سِتُّمِائَةِ جُنَاحٍ»
records.isnad_en: al-Husayn ibn ’Ali narrated to us, from Za’ida, from ’Asim, from Zirr, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God saw Gabriel in his [true] form at the Lote Tree, with six hundred wings.”

narrators.ar: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ

records.isnad_ar: نا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ:
records.matn_ar: {لَقَدْ رَأَى مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَى} [النجم: 18] ، قَالَ: «رَأَى رَفْرَفًا أَخْضَرَ قَدْ سَدَّ الْأُفُقَ» - يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم -
records.isnad_en: ’Abdullah ibn Numayr and Abu Mu’awiya narrated to us, from al-A’mash, from Ibrahim, from ’Alqama, from ’Abdullah,
records.matn_en: on {He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord} [al-Najm: 18], he said: “He saw a green rafraf that had blocked the horizon” – meaning the Prophet ﷺ.

records.isnad_ar: نا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ حَجَّ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَأَنَّهُ رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ سَبْعَ حَصَيَاتٍ، وَجَعَلَ الْبَيْتَ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، وَمِنًى عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «هَذَا مَقَامُ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ»
records.isnad_en: Ghundar narrated to us, from Shu’ba, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from ’Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid,
records.matn_en: that he performed Hajj with ’Abdullah, and that he stoned the Jamra with seven pebbles, placing the House on his left and Mina on his right, and then said: “This is the standing place of the one on whom Surat al-Baqara was revealed.”

records.isnad_ar: نا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «سِبَابُ الْمُؤْمِنِ فِسْقٌ، وَقِتَالُهُ كُفْرٌ»
records.isnad_en: Ghundar narrated to us, from Shu’ba, from Abu Wa’il, from ’Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
records.matn_en: “Insulting a believer is wickedness, and fighting him is disbelief.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ، وَمَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيُّ الذَّنْبِ أَعْظَمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِلَّهِ نِدًّا وَهُوَ خَلَقَكَ» قَالَ: قُلْتُ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: «أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَلَدَكَ خَشْيَةَ أَنْ يَطْعَمَ مَعَكَ» قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: «أَنْ تُزَانِيَ حَلِيلَةَ جَارِكَ»
records.isnad_en: ’Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Wasil and Mansur, from Abu Wa’il, from ’Amr ibn Shurahbil, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: I said: O Messenger of God, which sin is greatest with God? He said: “That you set up a rival to God while He created you.” I said: Then what? He said: “That you kill your child for fear that he will eat with you.” He said: Then what? He said: “That you commit adultery with your neighbor’s wife.”

records.isnad_ar: نا وَكِيعٌ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ ضَرَبَ الْخُدُودَ، وَشَقَّ الْجُيُوبَ، وَدَعَا بِدَعْوَى ⦗ص: 243⦘ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ»
records.isnad_en: Waki’ and ’Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Zubayd, from Ibrahim, from Masruq, from ’Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “He is not one of us who strikes the cheeks, tears the garments, and calls with the call [p. 243] of the pre-Islamic era.”

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ مَا تَقُولُ فِي رَجُلٍ مُؤَدِّي حَرِيصٌ عَلَى الْجِهَادِ، يَعْزِمُ عَلَيْنَا أُمَرَاؤَنَا فِي أَشْيَاءَ لَا نُحْصِيهَا؟ فَقَالَ: «مَا أَدْرِي مَا أَقُولُ إِلَّا أَنَّا كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا عَلِمْنَا لَا نُؤْمَرُ بِشَيْءٍ إِلَّا فَعَلْنَاهُ»
records.isnad_en: Abu Mu’awiya narrated to us, from al-A’mash, from Sufyan, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: A man came to him and said: O Abu ’Abd al-Rahman, what do you say about an upright man, eager for jihad, while our commanders impose on us countless things? He said: “I do not know what to say, except that we were with the Prophet ﷺ, and we were not commanded anything that we did not do.”

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّبٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: خَرَجَ رَجُلٌ يَطْرُقُ فَرَسًا لَهُ، فَمَرَّ بِمَسْجِدِ بَنِي حَنِيفَةَ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ، فَقَرَأَهُمْ إِمَامُهُمْ بِكَلَامِ مُسَيْلِمَةَ، فَأَتَى ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ فَعَاتَبَهُمْ وَاسْتَتَابَهُمْ، فَتَابُوا إِلَّا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ النَّوَّاحَةِ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: لَوْلَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «لَوْلَا أَنَّكَ رَسُولٌ، لَضَرَبْتُ عُنُقَكَ» وَأَمَّا الْيَوْمَ فَلَسْتَ بِرَسُولٍ، قُمْ يَا خَرَشَةُ فَاضْرِبْ عُنُقَهُ، فَقَامَ فَضَرَبَ عُنُقَهُ
records.isnad_en: Abu Mu’awiya narrated to us, from al-A’mash, from Abu Ishaq, from Haritha ibn Mudarrib, who said:
records.matn_en: A man went out at night riding his mare, passed the mosque of Banu Hanifa and prayed in it, and their imam recited to them the speech of Musaylima. He went to Ibn Mas’ud, who sent for them, rebuked them and asked them to repent; they repented except ’Abdullah ibn al-Nawwaha. ’Abdullah said: Were it not that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Were it not that you are an envoy, I would strike your neck,” but today you are not an envoy – stand, O Kharasha, and strike his neck. He stood and struck his neck.

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ بَدْرٍ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَسَارَى؟» فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَوْمُكَ، وَأَهْلُكَ، فَاسْتَبِقْهِمْ وَاسْتَتِبْهُمْ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ. وَقَالَ عُمَرُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَذَّبُوكَ، وَأَخْرَجُوكَ، قَدِّمْهُمْ نَضْرِبُ أَعْنَاقَهُمْ. فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَوَاحَةَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ رَحِمُكَ. قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ قَامَ فَدَخَلَ ⦗ص: 245⦘ ، فَقَالَ نَاسٌ: يَأْخُذُ بِقَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَقَالَ نَاسٌ: يَأْخُذُ بِقَوْلِ عُمَرَ، وَقَالَ نَاسٌ: يَأْخُذُ بِقَوْلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَوَاحَةَ. ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: " إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُلِينَ قُلُوبَ رِجَالٍ فِيهِ حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَلْيَنُ مِنَ اللَّبَنِ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُشَدِّدُ قُلُوبَ رِجَالٍ فِيهِ حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَشَدَّ مِنَ الْحِجَارَةِ، وَإِنَّ مَثَلَكَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ كَمَثَلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عليه السلام قَالَ: {فَمَنْ تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّي وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ} [إبراهيم: 36] . وَإِنَّ مَثَلَكَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ كَمَثَلِ عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ عليه السلام، قَالَ: {إِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ وَإِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ} [المائدة: 118] . وَإِنَّ مَثَلَكَ يَا عُمَرُ كَمَثَلِ مُوسَى قَالَ: {رَبَّنَا اطْمِسْ عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَاشْدُدْ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ} [يونس: 88] . وَإِنَّ مَثَلَكَ يَا عُمَرُ كَمَثَلِ نُوحٍ عليه السلام، قَالَ: {رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ⦗ص: 246⦘ الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا} [نوح: 26] . أَنْتُمْ عَالَةٌ فَلَا يَنْفَلِتَنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا بِفِدَاءٍ، أَوْ ضَرْبَةِ عُنُقٍ ". فَقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا سُهَيْلَ بْنَ بَيْضَاءَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ يَذْكُرُ الْإِسْلَامَ. قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَمَا رَأَيْتُنِي فِي يَوْمٍ أَخْوَفَ أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَيَّ حِجَارَةٌ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِنِّي فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ حَتَّى قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِلَّا سُهَيْلَ بْنَ بَيْضَاءَ» . فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ: {مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرَى حَتَّى يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ} [الأنفال: 67] ، إِلَى آخِرِ الثَّلَاثَةِ الْآيَاتِ
records.isnad_en: Abu Mu’awiya narrated to us, from al-A’mash, from ’Amr ibn Murra, from Abu ’Ubayda, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: On the day of Badr the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “What do you say about these captives?” Abu Bakr said: O Messenger of God, they are your people and your family; spare them and ask them to repent, perhaps God will relent toward them. ’Umar said: O Messenger of God, they called you a liar and expelled you; bring them forward and we will strike their necks. ’Abdullah ibn Rawaha said: O Messenger of God, [consider] your kinship. He said: The Messenger of God ﷺ was silent and did not reply to them anything, then rose and went in [p. 245], and some people said: He will take Abu Bakr’s view; others said: He will take ’Umar’s view; and others said: He will take ’Abdullah ibn Rawaha’s view. Then the Messenger of God ﷺ came out to them and said: “God softens the hearts of men for His sake until they are softer than milk, and God hardens the hearts of men for His sake until they are harder than stones. Your likeness, O Abu Bakr, is that of Abraham ؑ, who said: {Whoever follows me is of me; and whoever disobeys me, indeed You are Forgiving and Merciful} [Ibrahim: 36]. And your likeness, O Abu Bakr, is that of Jesus son of Mary ؑ, who said: {If You punish them, they are Your servants; and if You forgive them, indeed You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise} [al-Ma’ida: 118]. And your likeness, O ’Umar, is that of Moses, who said: {Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so they will not believe until they see the painful punishment} [Yunus: 88]. And your likeness, O ’Umar, is that of Noah ؑ, who said: {My Lord, do not leave upon [p. 246] the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant} [Nuh: 26]. You are needy, so none of them shall escape except by ransom or the striking of the neck.” Ibn Mas’ud said: I said: O Messenger of God, except Suhayl ibn Bayda’, for I heard him mention Islam. He said: The Messenger of God ﷺ was silent, and I never saw myself on any day more afraid that stones would fall on me from the sky than I was on that day, until the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Except Suhayl ibn Bayda’.” So God revealed: {It is not for a prophet to have captives until he has inflicted slaughter upon the enemy in the land} [al-Anfal: 67] to the end of the three verses.

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو الْمُوَرِّعِ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَوْسَجَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي الْهُذَيْلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: «اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي، فَأَحْسَنْ خُلُقِي»
records.isnad_en: Abu al-Muwarri’ narrated to us, from ’Asim, from ’Awsaja, from ’Abdullah ibn Abi al-Hudhayl, from ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud,
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ used to say: “O God, You have made my creation good, so make my character good.”

records.isnad_ar: نا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي الْفُرَاتِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ ⦗ص:
records.matn_ar: 247⦘ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَعْيُنِ الْعَبْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «مَنْ قَتَلَ حَيَّةً فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ كَافِرًا»
records.isnad_en: Zayd ibn al-Hubab narrated to us, from Dawud ibn Abi al-Furat, from Muhammad [p. 247] ibn Zayd, from Abu al-A’yan al-’Abdi, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
records.matn_en: “Whoever kills a snake is as though he killed a disbeliever.”

records.isnad_ar: نا إِسْحَاقُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم «يَنَامُ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ، فَمَا يُعْرَفُ نَوْمُهُ إِلَّا بِنَفْخِهِ، حَتَّى يَقُومَ فَيَمْضِي فِي صَلَاتِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Ishaq narrated to us, from Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad, from al-A’mash, from Ibrahim, from ’Alqama, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ “would sleep while prostrating, and his sleep would be known only by his breathing, until he rose and continued his prayer.”

narrators.en: ’Abdullah, and ’Abdullah heard of a sinking of the earth, and

records.isnad_ar: نا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
records.matn_ar: وَسَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بِخَسْفَ، فَقَالَ: كُنَّا ⦗ص: 248⦘ أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَعُدُّ الْآيَاتِ بَرَكَاتٍ، وَأَنْتُمْ تَعُدُّونَهَا تَخْوِيفًا، إِنَّا بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَيْسَ مَعَنَا مَاءٌ، فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «اطْلُبُوا مَنْ مَعَهُ فَضْلُ مَاءٍ» ، فَأُتِيَ مَاءٌ يُصِبُّهُ فِي إِنَاءٍ، ثُمَّ وَضَعَ كَفَّهُ فِيهِ، فَجَعَلَ الْمَاءُ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَصَابِعِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «حَيَّ عَلَى الطَّهُورِ الْمُبَارَكِ، وَالْبَرَكَةِ مِنَ اللَّهِ» . قَالَ: فَشَرِبْنَا مَعَهُ. وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ تَسْبِيحَ الطَّعَامِ وَنَحْنُ نَأْكُلُ
records.isnad_en: ’Ubaydullah ibn Musa narrated to us, Isra’il informed us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from ’Alqama, from ’Abdullah, and ’Abdullah heard of a sinking of the earth, and said [p. 248]:
records.matn_en: We, the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ, used to count signs as blessings, while you count them as a warning. While we were with the Messenger of God ﷺ and had no water, the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Look for someone who has some water left.” Water was brought, and he poured it into a vessel, then put his palm in it, and the water began to come out from between his fingers. Then he said: “Come to the blessed purifier, and the blessing is from God.” He said: And we drank with him. And ’Abdullah said: We used to hear the glorification of food while we ate.

records.isnad_ar: نا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ «إِذَا قَعَدَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأُولَيَيْنِ كَأَنَّهُ عَلَى الرَّضْفِ» ، فَقُلْتُ لِسَعْدٍ: حَتَّى مَتَى تَقُومَ؟ قَالَ: حَتَّى يَقُومَ
records.isnad_en: Ghundar narrated to us, from Shu’ba, from Sa’d ibn Ibrahim, from Abu ’Ubayda, from his father ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud,
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ, when he sat in the first two rak’as, “it was as if he were on hot stones.” I said to Sa’d: Until when would he stay? He said: Until he stood.

records.isnad_ar: نا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الْهَجَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مُنَادِيًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُنَادِي: يَا آدَمَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تَبْعَثَ بَعْثًا مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِكَ إِلَى النَّارِ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُ: مِنْ كَمْ؟: فَيَقُولُ لَهُ: مِنْ كُلِّ مِائَةٍ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ ". فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ: فَمَنِ النَّاجِي مِنَّا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ؟ فَقَالَ: «مَا أَنْتُمْ فِي النَّاسِ إِلَّا كَالشَّامَةِ فِي صَدْرِ الْبَعِيرِ»
records.isnad_en: ’Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from al-Hajari, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “God will send a caller on the Day of Resurrection who will call: O Adam, God commands you to send out a contingent of your descendants to the Fire. He will say to him: From how many? He will say to him: From every hundred, ninety-nine.” A man from the people said to him: Then who among us is saved after that? He said: “You are among the people only like a mark on the chest of a camel.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الْهَجَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.matn_ar: قَالَ ⦗ص: 250⦘ : «نَحْنُ الْآخِرُونَ الْأَوَّلُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَإِنَّ الْأَكْثَرِينَ هُمُ الْأَسْفَلُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ قَالَ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا، عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ، وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ»
records.isnad_en: ’Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from al-Hajari, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said [p. 250]:
records.matn_en: “We are the last, the first on the Day of Resurrection. The majority will be the lowest, except for one who says thus and thus, to his right, to his left, in front of him and behind him.”

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الْهَجَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَكُمْ خَادِمُهُ بِطَعَامِهِ فَلْيُنَاوِلْهِ مِنْهُ، فَإِنَّهُ وَلِيَ حَرَّهُ»
records.isnad_en: Abu Mu’awiya narrated to us, from al-Hajari, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “When your servant brings you your food, let him hand him some of it, for he bore its heat.”

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الْهَجَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.matn_ar: قَالَ ⦗ص: 251⦘ : «مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَتَوَضَّأُ فَيُحْسِنُ الْوَضُوءَ، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مَسْجِدًا مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ فَيَخْطُو خُطْوَةً إِلَّا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ بِهَا حَسَنَةً، وَحَطَّ عَنْهُ بِهَا خَطِيئَةً، وَرَفَعَ لَهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً»
records.isnad_en: Abu Mu’awiya narrated to us, from al-Hajari, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said [p. 251]:
records.matn_en: “No man does ablution well, then comes to one of the mosques and takes a step, but that God writes for him a good deed by it, removes a sin from him by it, and raises him a degree by it.”

records.isnad_ar: نا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الْهَجَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَأْدُبَةُ اللَّهِ، فَتَعَلَّمُوا مِنْ مَأْدُبَةِ اللَّهِ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ، إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ حَبْلُ اللَّهِ، وَهُوَ النُّورُ الْمُبِينُ، وَالشَّافِعُ النَافِعُ، عِصْمَةٌ لِمَنْ يَتَمَسَّكُ بِهِ، وَنَجَاةٌ لِمَنْ تَبِعَهُ، لَا يَعْوَجُّ فَيُقَوَّمَ، وَلَا يَزِيغُ فَيُسْتَعْتَبَ، وَلَا تَنْقَضِي عَجَائِبُهُ، وَلَا يَخْلُقُ عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الرَّدِّ، أَتْلُوهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْجُرُكُمْ عَلَى تِلَاوَتِهِ بِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ مِنْهُ عَشْرَ حَسَنَاتٍ، أَمَا إِنِّي لَا أَقُولُ أَلِفٌ وَلَامٌ، وَلَكِنْ أَلِفٌ عَشْرًا، وَلَامٌ عَشْرًا»
records.isnad_en: Abu Mu’awiya narrated to us, from al-Hajari, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “This Qur’an is God’s banquet, so learn from God’s banquet what you can. This Qur’an is the rope of God, the clear light and the beneficial intercessor, a protection for whoever holds to it and salvation for whoever follows it. It does not bend so as to need straightening, nor deviate so as to need to be set right; its wonders do not end, and it does not wear out through repetition. Recite it, for God will reward you for reciting it, ten good deeds for each letter. I do not say that Alif-Lam [is one letter], but alif is ten and lam is ten.”

records.isnad_ar: نا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ الْبُرْجُمِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ مِنْ دَارِهِ فَدَخَلْنَا الْمَسْجِدَ، وَقَدْ رَكَعَ الْإِمَامُ وَرَكَعْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى اتَّصَلْنَا بِالصَّفِّ، فَمَرَّ بِهِ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ. فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلَاةَ، قُلْنَا لَهُ: كَأَنَّهُ رَاعَكَ تَسْلِيمُ الرَّجُلِ؟ فَقَالَ: أَجَلْ كَانَ، فَقَالَ: «مِنِ اقْتَرِابِ السَّاعَةِ أَنْ تُتَّخِذَ الْمَسَاجِدُ طُرُقًا، وَأَنْ يُسَلِّمَ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ بِالْمَعْرِفَةِ، وَأَنْ يَعْلُوَ الْخَيْلُ وَالنِّسَاءُ، ثُمَّ تَرْخُصَ فَلَا تَعْلُو أَبَدًا»
records.isnad_en: Ibn Idris narrated to us, from Husayn ibn ’Abd al-Rahman, from ’Abd al-A’la ibn al-Hakam, from Kharija ibn al-Salt al-Burjumi, who said:
records.matn_en: We went out with Ibn Mas’ud from his house and entered the mosque when the imam had bowed, and we bowed with him until we joined the row. A man passed him and said: Peace be upon you, O Abu ’Abd al-Rahman. Ibn Mas’ud said: God and His Messenger spoke the truth. When he finished the prayer, we said to him: It seems the man’s greeting startled you? He said: Yes. He said: “Among the nearing of the Hour is that mosques will be taken as thoroughfares, that people will be greeted only by acquaintance, and that the price of horses and women will rise, then fall and never rise again.”

records.isnad_ar: نا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنَ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «لِيَلِينِي مِنْكُمْ أُولُو الْأَحْلَامِ وَالنُّهَى، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، وَلَا تَخْتَلِفُوا فَتَخْتَلِفَ قُلُوبُكُمْ»
records.isnad_en: Yunus ibn Muhammad narrated to us, from Yazid ibn Zuray’, from Khalid, from Abu Ma’shar, from Ibrahim, from ’Alqama, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Let those of you who are mature and sensible stand directly behind me, then those who follow them, then those who follow them, and do not differ, lest your hearts differ.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا شُعْبَةُ،
records.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ: أَنْبَأَنَا، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، قَالَ: كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ: إِنَّ الْكَذِبَ لَا يَصْلُحُ مِنْهُ جَدٌّ، وَلَا هَزْلٌ، وَلَا يَعِدُ الرَّجُلُ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ لَا يُنْجِزُهُ لَهُ، وَإِنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَنَا: «أَلَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِالْعَضَهِ؟ هِيَ النَّمِيمَةُ الْقَالَةُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ» وَإِنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَنَا: " لَا يَزَالُ الرَّجُلُ يَصْدِقُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ صَدِيقًا، وَلَا يَزَالُ الرَّجُلُ يَكْذِبُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَذَّابًا، أَلَا تَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُ يُقَالُ لِلصَّادِقِ: صَدَقَ وَبَرَّ " قَالَ: " وَيُقَالُ لِلْكَاذِبِ: كَذَبَ وَفَجَرَ، وَإِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ، وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ، وَإِنَّ الْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ "
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, Shu’ba narrated to us, Abu Ishaq said: He informed us, from Abu al-Ahwas, who said:
records.matn_en:
’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud used to say: Lying is not proper, in earnest or in jest, and a man should not promise something to a child and then not fulfill it for him. And Muhammad ﷺ said to us: “Shall I not tell you what al-’adah is? It is slander, the gossip between people.”

And Muhammad ﷺ said to us: “A man continues to tell the truth until he is recorded with God as truthful, and a man continues to lie until he is recorded with God as a liar. Do you not see that it is said of the truthful: He spoke truth and was righteous?” He said: “And it is said of the liar: He lied and was wicked. Truthfulness guides to righteousness, and righteousness guides to Paradise; and lying guides to wickedness, and wickedness guides to the Fire.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، نَا الْحَارِثُ بْنُ حَصِيرَةَ، نَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ وَرُبُعُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، لَكُمْ رُبُعُهَا وَالنَّاسُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَرْبَاعِهَا؟» ، قَالَ: فَقَالُوا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ: «فَكَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ وَثُلُثُهَا؟» قَالُوا: فَذَاكَ الْخَيْرُ، قَالَ: «كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ وَالشَّطْرُ؟» قَالُوا: فَذَاكَ أَكْثَرُ، قَالُوا: فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ⦗ص: 255⦘ : «أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِائَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ صَفًّا، أَنْتُمْ مِنْهَا ثَمَانُونَ صَفًّا»
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, ’Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad narrated to us, al-Harith ibn Hasira narrated to us, al-Qasim ibn ’Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from his father, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “How will you be if you are a quarter of the people of Paradise, with a quarter for you and the other people three quarters?” He said: They said: God and His Messenger know best. He said: “And how if you are a third?” They said: That is good. He said: “How if it is the half?” They said: That is more. The Messenger of God ﷺ said [p. 255]: “The people of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection are one hundred and twenty rows, of which you are eighty rows.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، نَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ بَهْدَلَةَ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّفَّةِ مَاتَ، فَوَجَدُوا فِي دِينَارَيْنِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «عَلَيْهِ كَيَّتَانِ»
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, ’Asim ibn Bahdala narrated to us, from Zirr, from Ibn Mas’ud,
records.matn_en: that a man of the People of the Suffa died and they found two dinars with him. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Two brandings are upon him.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، نَا الْأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ أَحَدٌ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ، وَلَا يَدْخُلُ النَّارَ أَحَدٌ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ»
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, ’Abd al-’Aziz ibn Muslim narrated to us, al-A’mash narrated to us, from Ibrahim, from ’Alqama, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “No one will enter Paradise who has in his heart the weight of a grain of arrogance, and no one will enter the Fire who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of faith.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا هَمَّامٌ، قَالَ: نَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، عَنْ أَبِي ⦗ص: 256⦘ الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «الْعَيْنَانِ تَزْنِيَانِ، وَالْيَدَانِ تَزْنِيَانِ، وَالرَّجُلَانِ تَزْنِيَانِ، وَالْفَرَجُ يَزْنِي»
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, Hammam narrated to us, who said: ’Asim ibn Abi al-Najud narrated to us, from Abu [p. 256] al-Duha, from Masruq, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The two eyes commit adultery, the two hands commit adultery, the two feet commit adultery, and the private part commits adultery.”

narrators.ar: أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ ابْتَعَثَ نَبِيَّهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِإِدْخَالِ رَجُلٍ الْجَنَّةَ، فَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ كَنِيسَةً فَإِذَا هُوَ بِيَهُودَ، وَإِذَا يَهُودِيٌّ يَقْرَأُ التَّوْرَاةَ، فَلَمَّا أَتَى عَلَى صِفَتِهِ أَمْسَكُوا، وَفِي نَاحِيَتِهَا رَجُلٌ مَرِيضٌ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا لَكُمْ أَمْسَكْتُمْ؟» فَقَالَ الْمَرِيضُ: إِنَّهُمْ أَتَوْا عَلَى صِفَةِ نَبِيٍّ فَأَمْسَكُوا، ثُمَّ جَاءَ الْمَرِيضُ يَحْبُو حَتَّى ⦗ص: 257⦘ أَخَذَ التَّوْرَاةَ، وَقَالَ: ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ، فَقَالَ: فَقَرَأَ حَتَّى أَتَى عَلَى صِفَتِهِ، فَقَالَ: هَذِهِ صِفَتُكَ وَصِفَةُ أُمَّتِكَ فَقَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، ثُمَّ مَاتَ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لُوا أَخَاكُمْ»
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from ’Ata’ ibn al-Sa’ib, from Abu ’Ubayda ibn ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: God sent His Prophet ﷺ to cause a man to enter Paradise. The Prophet entered a synagogue and there were Jews; a Jew was reading the Torah, and when he came to the description of him, they stopped. In a corner of it was a sick man. The Prophet ﷺ said: “Why did you stop?” The sick man said: They came upon the description of a prophet and stopped. Then the sick man came crawling until he [p. 257] took the Torah, and said: Lift your hand. He read until he reached his description and said: This is your description and the description of your community. He said: I bear witness that there is no god but God, and that you are the Messenger of God. Then he died, and the Prophet ﷺ said: “Take charge of your brother.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: "
records.matn_ar: عَجِبَ رَبُّنَا مِنْ رَجُلَيْنِ: رَجُلٌ ثَارَ مِنْ فِرَاشِهِ وَلِحَافِهِ مِنْ بَيْنِ حِبِسِّهِ وَأَهْلِهِ إِلَى صَلَاتِهِ، رَغْبَةً فِيمَا عِنْدِي، وَشَفَقَةً مِمَّا عِنْدِي، وَرَجُلٌ غَزَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فَفَرَّ أَصْحَابُهُ، فَعَلِمَ مَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْفِرَارِ، وَمَا لَهُ فِي الرُّجُوعِ، فَرَجَعَ حَتَّى أُهَرِيقَ دَمُهُ، فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِمَلَائِكَتِهِ: يَا مَلَائِكَتِي انْظُرُوا إِلَى عَبْدِي رَجَعَ حَتَّى أُهَرِيقَ دَمُهُ رَغْبَةً فِيمَا عِنْدِي، وَشَفَقَةً مِمَّا عِنْدِي "
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from ’Ata’ ibn al-Sa’ib, from Murra, from ’Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Our Lord marvels at two men: a man who leaps from his bed and his covers, from among his loved ones and his family, to his prayer, desiring what is with Me and fearing what is with Me; and a man who fought in the cause of God, and his companions fled, and he knew what it meant for him to flee and what was for him in returning, so he returned until his blood was shed. God Exalted says to His angels: My angels, look at My servant, who returned until his blood was shed, desiring what is with Me and fearing what is with Me.”

narrators.ar: عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: آكِلَ الرِّبَا، وَمُوكِلَهُ، وَشَاهِدَهُ، وَكَاتِبَهُ "
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, Abu ’Awana narrated to us, from Simak, from ’Abd al-Rahman ibn ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud – he heard it from him – from his father, who said:
records.matn_en: “The Messenger of God ﷺ cursed the one who consumes usury, the one who feeds it to others, its witness and its scribe.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، نَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أُذُنَانَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَسْلَفْتُ عَلْقَمَةَ أَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ، فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ عَطَاؤُهُ قُلْتُ لَهُ: اقْضِنِي، فَقَالَ: أَخِّرْنِي إِلَى قَابِلٍ، فَأَبَيْتُ عَلَيْهِ، فَأَخَذْتُهَا مِنْهُ، قَالَ: فَأَتَيْتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: بَرَّحْتُ وَقَدْ مَنَعْتَنِي، فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ هُوَ عَمَلُكَ، فَقَالَ: وَمَا شَأْنِي، قَالَ: إِنَّكَ حَدَّثَتْنِي عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «إِنَّ السَّلَفَ يَجْرِي مَجْرَى شَطْرِ الصَّدَقَةِ» ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، فَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ، قَالَ: فَخُذِ الْآنَ
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, ’Ata’ ibn al-Sa’ib narrated to us, from Ibn Udhnan, who said:
records.matn_en: I lent ’Alqama two thousand dirhams, and when his stipend came out I said to him: Repay me. He said: Defer me until next year. I refused, and took it from him. He said: Then I came to him afterwards and he said: You have distressed me and deprived me [of reward]. I said: Yes, it is your own doing. He said: How so? He said: You narrated to me from ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “A loan is in the position of half a charity.” He said: Yes, it is so. He said: Then take it now.

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ ⦗ص: 259⦘ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنْتُ غُلَامًا يَافِعًا أَرْعَى غَنَمًا لِعُقْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَقَدْ فَرَّا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَقَالَا: يَا غُلَامُ هَلْ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ لَبَنٍ تَسْقِينَا؟ فَقُلْتُ: إِنِّي مُؤْتَمَنٌ وَلَسْتُ بِسَاقِيكُمَا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «هَلْ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ جَذَعَةٍ لَمْ يَنْزُ عَلَيْهَا الْفَحْلُ» ، فَاعْتَقَلَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَسَحَ الضِّرْعَ وَدَعَا، ثُمَّ أَتَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِصَخْرَةٍ مُنْقَعِرَةٍ، أَوْ مُنَقَّرَةٍ، فَاحْتَلَبَ مِنْهَا، فَشَرِبَ وَشَرِبَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه وَشَرِبْتُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلضَّرْعِ: «اقْلُصْ» ، فَقَلَصَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَقُلْتُ: عَلِّمْنِي مِنْ هَذَا الْقَوْلِ، قَالَ: «إِنَّكَ غُلَامٌ مُعَلَّمٌ» . فَأَخَذْتُ مِنْ فِيهِ سَبْعِينَ سُورَةً لَا يُنَازِعُنِي فِيهَا أَحَدٌ
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from ’Asim, from Zirr ibn Hubaysh [p. 259], from ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, who said:
records.matn_en: I was a young boy grazing sheep for ’Uqba ibn Abi Mu’ayt when the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr came, fleeing from the polytheists, and said: O boy, do you have any milk to give us to drink? I said: I am entrusted and I will not give you to drink. The Prophet ﷺ said: “Do you have a young ewe that no ram has covered?” The Prophet ﷺ held it, stroked the udder and prayed, then Abu Bakr brought a hollowed rock, or a hollowed bowl, and milked into it; the Prophet ﷺ drank, Abu Bakr drank, and I drank. Then he said to the udder: “Contract,” and it contracted. I came to him afterwards and said: Teach me some of this saying. He said: “You are a taught boy.” And I took from his mouth seventy surahs in which no one disputed me.

records.isnad_ar: نا عَفَّانُ، نَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، نَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ⦗ص: 260⦘ ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَلِ جَبَلٍ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي وَنَحْنُ نِيَامٌ إِذْ مَرَّتْ بِهِ حَيَّةٌ فَاسْتَيْقَظْنَا، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: «مَنْعَهَا مِنْكُمِ، الَّذِي مَنَعَكُمْ مِنْهَا» ، فَأُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ: {وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفًا} [المرسلات: 2] . فَأَخَذْتُهَا وَهِيَ رَطِبَةٌ مِنْ فِيهِ أَوْ فُوهُ رَطِبٌ بِهَا
records.isnad_en: ’Affan narrated to us, Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, ’Asim narrated to us, from Zirr, from ’Abdullah [p. 260], who said:
records.matn_en: We were with the Messenger of God ﷺ at the foot of a mountain; he was standing praying and we were asleep when a snake passed by him. We woke while he was saying: “What kept it from you is what kept you from it.” And there was revealed to him: {By those [winds] sent forth in succession, and the winds that blow violently} [al-Mursalat: 2]. I took it fresh from his mouth, or his mouth was moist with it.

records.isnad_ar: نا سِكِّينُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، نَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْهَجَرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «مَا عَالَ مَنِ اقْتَصَدَ»
records.isnad_en: Sikkin ibn ’Abd al-’Aziz narrated to us, Ibrahim al-Hajari narrated to us, from Abu al-Ahwas, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever is moderate does not become destitute.”

records.isnad_ar: نا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ⦗ص:
records.matn_ar: 261⦘ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ سَأَلَ وَلَهُ مَا يُغْنِيهِ، كَانَ خَدُوشًا أَوْ كَدُوشًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ» ، قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا غنَاؤُهُ؟ قَالَ: «خَمْسُونَ أَوْ قِيمَتُهَا مِنَ الذَّهَبِ»
records.isnad_en: Waki’ narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Hakim ibn Jubayr, from Muhammad ibn [p. 261] ’Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from his father, from ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever begs while he has enough will be scratched, or lacerated, on the Day of Resurrection.” It was said: O Messenger of God, what is sufficiency? He said: “Fifty [dirhams], or its value in gold.”

records.isnad_ar: نا طَلْقُ بْنُ غَنَامٍ، نَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «إِنَّ مِنَ الْبَيَانِ سِحْرًا، وَإِنَّ مِنَ الشَّعْرِ حِكْمَةً»
records.isnad_en: Talq ibn Ghannam narrated to us, Qays ibn al-Rabi’ narrated to us, from al-A’mash, from Ibrahim, from ’Ubayda, from ’Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Some eloquence is magic, and some poetry is wisdom.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَعِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَدُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ، وَنَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنَ الْجُوعِ فَإِنَّهُ بِئْسَ الضَّجِيعُ»
records.isnad_en: ’Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Humayd ibn ’Ata’, from ’Abdullah ibn al-Harith, from ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to say:
records.matn_en: “I seek refuge in God from a heart that does not humble itself, knowledge that does not benefit, a supplication that is not heard, a soul that is never satisfied, and from hunger, for it is a wretched bedfellow.”

records.isnad_ar: نا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 263⦘ عَوْنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: «إِذَا اخْتَلَفَ الْبَيِّعَانِ، فَالْقَوْلُ مَا قَالَ الْبَائِعُ وَالْمُبْتَاعُ بِالْخِيَارِ»
records.isnad_en: Ibn ’Uyayna and Yahya ibn Sa’id narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn ’Ajlan, from [p. 263] ’Awn ibn ’Abdullah, from Ibn Mas’ud, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “When the two parties to a sale disagree, the word is that of the seller, and the buyer has the option.”

records.isnad_ar: نا حَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، نَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ حَدَّثَهُمْ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " يَكُونُ فِي النَّارِ قَوْمٌ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ يَرْحَمُهُمُ اللَّهُ فَيُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنْهَا فَيَكُونُوا فِي أَدْنَى الْجَنَّةِ، فَيَغْتَسِلُونَ فِي نَهَرِ الْحَيَاةِ، يُسَمِّيهِمْ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ: الْجُهَنَّمِيُّونَ، لَوْ أَضَافَ أَحَدُهُمُ الْأَرْضَ لَأَطْعَمَهُمْ وَسَقَاهُمْ، وَفَرَشَهُمْ وَلَحَفَهُمْ - وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ - وَزَوَّجَهُمْ لَا يَنْقُصُهُ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا "
records.isnad_en: Hasan ibn Musa narrated to us, Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from ’Ata’ ibn al-Sa’ib, from ’Amr ibn Maymun, who said:
records.matn_en: Ibn Mas’ud narrated to them that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “There will be a people in the Fire for as long as God wills, then God will have mercy on them and bring them out; they will be in the lowest part of Paradise and bathe in the river of life. The people of Paradise will call them the Jahannamis. Were one of them to host the whole earth, he would feed them and give them drink, and furnish them and clothe them – and I think he said – and marry them, without that diminishing anything from him.”

narrators.en: ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, attributing it to the Prophet

records.isnad_ar: نا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، نَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، رَفَعَهُ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «كَانَتْ تَلْبِيَتُهُ لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ»
records.isnad_en: Yunus ibn Muhammad narrated to us, Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from Abu Ishaq, from ’Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from ’Abdullah ibn Mas’ud, attributing it to the Prophet, who said:
records.matn_en: “His talbiya was: At Your service, O God, at Your service; at Your service, You have no partner, at Your service. Indeed, all praise and blessing are Yours.”

records.isnad_ar: نا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي، فَإِذَا ⦗ص: 265⦘ سَجَدَ وَثَبَ الْحَسَنُ وَالْحُسَيْنُ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ، فَإِذَا أَرَادُوا أَنْ يَمْنَعُوهُمَا أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِمْ: أَنْ دَعُوهُمَا فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلَاةَ وَضَعَهُمَا فِي حِجْرِهِ. فَقَالَ: «مَنْ أَحَبَّنِي فَلْيُحِبَّ هَذَيْنِ»
records.isnad_en: ’Ubaydullah ibn Musa narrated to us, from ’Ali ibn Salih, from ’Asim, from Zirr ibn Hubaysh, from ’Abdullah, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ was praying, and when [p. 265] he prostrated, al-Hasan and al-Husayn would leap onto his back; when they wanted to stop them, he would signal to them to leave them be. When he finished the prayer he placed them in his lap and said: “Whoever loves me, let him love these two.”

records.isnad_ar: نا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَى بَيْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ، فَافْتَتَحَ سُورَةَ النِّسَاءِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ أَحَبَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ غَضًّا كَمَا أُنْزِلَ، فَلْيَقْرَأْ عَلَيَّ قِرَاءَةَ ابْنِ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ» ، ثُمَّ قَعَدَ، ثُمَّ سَأَلَ، فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: «سَلْ تُعْطَهُ، سَلْ تُعْطَهُ» ، قَالَ: فَفِيمَا سَأَلَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا لَا يَرْتَدُّ وَنَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَمُرَافَقَةَ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَعْلَى جُنَّةِ الْخُلْدِ
records.isnad_en: Mu’awiya ibn ’Amr narrated to us, from Za’ida, from ’Asim, from Zirr, from ’Abdullah,
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ came between Abu Bakr and ’Umar (may God be pleased with them) while ’Abdullah was leading the people in prayer, and he had begun Surat al-Nisa’. The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever loves to recite this Qur’an fresh as it was revealed, let him recite as Ibn Umm ’Abd recites.” Then he sat and asked [God], and the Prophet ﷺ kept saying: “Ask, you shall be given; ask, you shall be given.” He said: And among what he asked was: O God, I ask You for faith that does not revert, bliss that does not run out, and the companionship of Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in the highest Garden of Eternity.

records.isnad_ar: نا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنَّا يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ كُلُّ ثَلَاثَةٍ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ، فَكَانَ أَبُو لُبَابَةَ وَعَلِيٌّ رضي الله عنهما زَمِيلَيْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكَانَ إِذَا حَانَتْ عُقْبَةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَا: ارْكَبْ حَتَّى نَمْشِي، فَيَقُولُ: «مَا أَنْتُمَا بِأَقْوَى عَلَى الْمَشْيِ مِنِّي، وَلَا أَنَا أَغْنَى عَنِ الْأَجْرِ مِنْكُمَا»
records.isnad_en: Yūnus b. Muḥammad narrated to us, from Ḥammād b. Salama, from ʿĀṣim, from Zirr b. Ḥubaysh, from Ibn Masʿūd, who said:
records.matn_en: On the day of Badr, every three of us shared a camel. Abū Lubāba and ʿAlī ؓ were the Messenger of God’s ﷺ two companions in taking turns riding. When the Prophet’s ﷺ turn came, they would say: 'Ride, and let us walk.' He would reply: 'Neither are you stronger at walking than I am, nor am I less in need of the reward than you are.'

records.isnad_ar: نا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «أَخَذْتُ مِنْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبْعِينَ سُورَةً لَا يُنَازِعُنِي فِيهَا أَحَدٌ»
records.isnad_en: Yūnus b. Muḥammad narrated to us, from Ḥammād b. Salama, from ʿĀṣim, from Zirr, from Ibn Masʿūd, who said:
records.matn_en: 'I learned seventy suras directly from the mouth of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and no one disputes my knowledge of them.'

records.isnad_ar: نا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: تَحَدَّثْنَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ حَتَّى أَكْثَرْنَا الْحَدِيثَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى أَهْلِينَا، فَلَمَّا غَدَوْنَا عَلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: " إِنَّهَا عُرِضَتْ عَلَيَّ اللَّيْلَةَ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ بِأُمَمِهَا وَاتِّبَاعِهَا مِنْ أُمَمِهَا، فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ مَعَهُ الثَّلَاثَةُ مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ، وَالنَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ مَعَهُ الْعِصَابَةُ مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ، وَالنَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ مَعَهُ النَّفْرُ الْيَسِيرُ، وَالنَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ مَعَهُ الرَّجُلُ الْوَاحِدُ مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ، وَالنَّبِيُّ يَمُرُّ مَا مَعَهُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ أَحَدٌ، وَقَدْ أَنْبَأَكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنْ لُوطٍ، وَقَالَ: {أَلَيْسَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رُشَيْدٌ} [هود: 78] ، قَالَ: حَتَّى أَتَى عَلَى مُوسَى فِي كَبْكَبَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُهُمْ أَعْجَبُونِي، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: مَنْ هَؤُلَاءِ؟ قَالَ: هَذَا أَخُوكَ مُوسَى بْنُ عِمْرَانَ، وَمَنْ تَبِعَهُ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، قُلْتُ: رَبِّ فَأَيْنَ أُمَّتِي؟ قَالَ: انْظُرْ عَنْ يَمِينِكِ فَإِذَا الظِّرَابُ: ظِرَابُ مَكَّةَ قَدْ سُدَّتْ بِوُجُوهِ الرِّجَالِ. قَالَ: قُلْتُ: رَبِّ مَنْ هَؤُلَاءِ؟ قَالَ: هَؤُلَاءِ أُمَّتِكَ، قَالَ لِي: أَرَضِيتَ؟ قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: وَإِنَّ مَعَ هَؤُلَاءِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةِ لَا حِسَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ ". فَأَنْشَأَ عُكَّاشَةُ بْنُ مِحْصَنٍ، أَخُو بَنِي أَسَدِ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ، فَقَالَ: يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ⦗ص: 268⦘ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ، فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ» فَأَنْشَأَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ، فَقَالَ: يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ. فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ عليه السلام: «لَقَدْ سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ» ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ يَوْمَئِذٍ: «أَرْجُو أَنْ يَكُونَ مَنْ تَبِعَنِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي رُبُعَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ - وَكَبَّرْنَا - ثُمَّ قَالَ: «أَرْجُو أَنْ تَكُونُوا الثُّلُثَ» ، قَالَ: فَكَبَّرْنَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «أَرْجُو أَنْ تَكُونُوا الشَّطْرَ» ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: {ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ، وَثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْآخِرِينَ} [الواقعة: 40] . قَالَ: فَذَكَرَ لَنَا أَنَّ رِجَالًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ تَرَاجَعُوا بَيْنَهُمْ فَقَالُوا: مَا تَرَوْنَ عَمَلَ هَؤُلَاءِ السَّبْعِينَ الَّذِينَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةِ لَا حِسَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَتَّى أُنَاسًا وُلِدُوا فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، لَمْ يُزَايِلَوهُ حَتَّى مَاتُوا عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ: وَنَمَا حَدِيثُهُمْ حَتَّى بَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ كَذَلِكَ، وَلَكِنَّهُمُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَكْتَوُونَ، وَلَا يَسْتَرِقُّونَ، وَلَا يَتَطَيَّرُونَ، وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ» ، قَالَ: وَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ - فِدًى لَكُمْ أَبِي وَأُمِّي - أَنْ تَكُونُوا مِنَ السَّبْعِينَ، فَإِنَّ عَجَزْتُمْ وَقَصَّرْتُمْ فَكُونُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الظِّرَابِ، فَإِنْ عَجَزْتُمْ وَقَصَّرْتُمْ فَكُونُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأُفُقِ، فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُ عِنْدَهُ أُنَاسًا يَتَهَوَّشُونَ كَثِيرًا»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥasan b. Mūsā narrated to us, from Ḥammād, from Shaybān b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Qatāda, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn, from Ibn Masʿūd, who said:
records.matn_en: One night we conversed at length in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, then returned to our families. When we came to the Prophet of God ﷺ the next morning, he said: 'Last night the prophets were shown to me, each with the people of his community who followed him. One prophet passed with three followers; another with a band of followers; another with a small group; another with just one man; and another passed without anyone from his people. God has informed you about Lot, when he said: {Is there not among you a right-minded man?} [Hūd 11:78]. Then Moses passed with a great company of the Children of Israel.
